blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Aspiring young journalists received their first introduction to newsroom work as Inquirer.net welcomed a new batch of volunteers through an orientation program in Makati City on Friday, Oct. 30. Held at work.able, Robinsons Summit Center, the session covered the fundamentals of news gathering, reporting and storytelling, as well as the responsible use of artificial intelligence in journalism. Inquirer senior manager for digital strategy Ralph Gurango led the orientation, introducing participants to the history of the Inquirer Volunteers program and their roles as contributors to the news organization.
